description: Erection of a single-storey rear infill extension. Enlargement of the existing basement to create self contained unit with rear light well and access steps.
decision_conditions: Reason : 1 - The proposed use of the basement as self-contained unit and stairwell access would have a serious and adverse effect on the amenities enjoyed by neighbouring properties, by reason of noise, disturbance and general pedestrian and vehicular activity at and within the vicinity of the site contrary to Local Plan Policy SC7 the Council's Residential Extension Guidelines (2024) and the intent of the National Planning Policy Framework.

Reason : 2 - The proposed use of the basement as self-contained unit would fail to provide an adequate quality of accommodation for future occupants as the unit would have a poor outlook and access to daylight and sunlight levels, poor quality amenity space and so would be detrimental to the amenities enjoyed by prospective occupants of this development The proposal is therefore contrary to the Nationally Described Space Standards (NDSS), London Plan Policy D6, Local Plan Policies CC1, CC2, SC5 and the intent of the National Planning Policy Framework.

Reason : 3 - The proposed rear stairwell due to its position, design, would be an intrusive and incongruous addition to the property, involve unacceptable loss of garden space and diverge from the style of the host property and its neighbours contrary to Local Plan Policies CC1, CC2 and CC4 and the Council's Residential Extension Guidelines (2024) and the intent of the National Planning Policy Framework

Reason : 4 - The proposed infill extension by reason of its height and position adjacent to the neighbours boundary would be an intrusive and unneighbourly addition, having a serious and adverse effect on the amenities enjoyed by the occupants of neighbouring properties by loss of light, outlook and increased sense of enclosure. Thus, it is contrary to Local Plan policies SC7, CC1 and CC2 of Local Plan, Residential Extension Guidelines and the National Planning Policy Framework.
